```{r setup, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, include = FALSE }
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)
library(knitr)
library(here)

# Set inline hook to format integers and numbers with commas
# and Lancet-style midline decimals (23·4, not 23.4)

knitr::knit_hooks$set(inline = function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x) && !is.integer(x)) {
    formatC(
      x,
      format = "f",
      digits = 1,
      big.mark = ",",
      decimal.mark = "·"
    )
  } else if (is.integer(x)) {
    format(x, big.mark = ",")
  } else {
    midline(x)
  }
})

source(here::here("R", "Functions.R"))

# supplementary table numbers ("Table S1", ...) from chis_supplement.qmd
supp_tbl <- supp_tbl_refs()
```
